cities.name: Tallinn
cities.local_food_tip: Warm Estonian soups, potato dishes, veggie stews, rye bread and pastries — cozy Baltic comfort food full of simple, clean flavors.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏰 Tallinn Old Town Walls: Medieval towers, cobblestones and fairytale streets. → 🏛️ Town Hall Square: Classic northern architecture. → ☕ Cozy café in Old Town: Cinnamon pastries & warm drinks.

Afternoon: 🌊 Seaside Promenade (Pirita direction): Soft breeze, long Baltic coastline. → 🏛️ Kadriorg Park (Exterior): Elegant palace area with ponds and gardens. → 🍽️ Lunch: Veggie soups, salads, potato dishes. → 🎨 Kumu Art Museum (Exterior areas).

Sunset: 🌅 Patkuli Viewing Platform: Old-town rooftops glowing at golden hour.

Night: 🌃 Old Town Lantern Streets: Dessert cafés, peaceful medieval vibe.

ideas: 🌊 Long seaside walks with cool breeze
🍦 Ice cream on Town Hall Square
🎄 Christmas Market at Town Hall Square

public_transport_tips: 🚶 Old Town is best explored on foot.

cities.name: Haapsalu
cities.local_food_tip: Light Baltic meals like veggie soups, salads, rye bread and pastries — fresh and mild flavors.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌊 Haapsalu Promenade: Quiet seaside walkway. → 🏛️ Haapsalu Castle (Exterior): Medieval towers & walls. → ☕ Lakeside café.

Afternoon: 🏘️ Old Town wooden houses. → 🌿 Haapsalu Bay Nature Walk. → 🍽️ Lunch: Veg soups, salads, potato dishes. → 🎨 Little artisan shops.

Sunset: 🌅 Promenade golden reflections.

Night: 🌃 Calm waterfront lights + dessert stands.

cities.name: Narva
cities.local_food_tip: Warm eastern-style soups, potatoes, salads, rye bread and pastries — hearty but simple flavors.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏰 Narva Castle (Exterior): Riverside fortress with dramatic views. → 🌊 Narva River Promenade. → ☕ Riverside café.

Afternoon: 🌉 Narva Riverfront Walk. → 🏘️ Old streets near the castle. → 🍽️ Lunch: Veg soups, potato dishes, salads. → 🎨 Creative neighborhood corners.

Sunset: 🌅 Castle silhouettes over the river.

Night: 🌃 Peaceful riverside lights.
public_transport_tips: 🚆 Trains from Tallinn to Narva run frequently.

Afternoon: 🏘️ Old Town pastel streets. → 🌳 Riverwalk paths. → 🍽️ Lunch: Veg bowls, salads, potato dishes. → 🎨 Small art corners.

Sunset: 🌅 Beach horizon glowing.

Night: 🌃 Seaside lights + dessert stands.
